title: Choose the homepage arrangement
question: The station case stays. Which arrangement should the homepage use? The first is the picture you already kept.

options.label: Unequal sheets
options.thesis: A tall blue sheet in the middle, a small orange join ticket on it, and shorter notices around them.
options.viewport: Floating blue header, white side route card, masonry with empty space still in the case.
options.risk: The empty sheets read as a template, and the join ticket can look stuck on rather than like its own notice.

options.label: The wide sheet
options.thesis: One wide blue poster carries the sentence, and a row of short notices sits under it, including the orange join.
options.viewport: Thin blue header, a flush blue side rail, a wide lead poster, four short sheets in a row.
options.risk: The wide poster becomes an ordinary banner, and the row under it is the same height.

options.label: Join first
options.thesis: The orange join sheet is the largest thing on the page. The sentence sits in a tall blue sheet beside it.
options.viewport: Floating blue header, white side card, orange sheet dominant, blue sentence beside it, short notices below.
options.risk: The invitation shouts over who the organization is, and a newcomer may not know what they are joining.
